description: This PHP class defines a decorator for the Kpi entity, providing methods to manipulate Kpi objects, specifically to set a JobTitle by its ID, within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system.

classes.name: KpiDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for the Kpi entity, adding auxiliary methods such as setting a JobTitle by ID.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the KpiDecorator with a Kpi object.

methods.name: getKpi
methods.description: Returns the Kpi entity associated with this decorator.

methods.name: setJobTitleById
methods.description: Sets the JobTitle of the associated Kpi to the JobTitle with the specified ID.
